subject: Fincobank — Audit logs / data access evidence (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Adams <r.adams@fincobank.com>, Fincobank Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs — post-call recap & requested evidence

Hi Rachel / Security team,

Thanks again for taking the time on today's call — good to meet the team. As promised, collating the follow-ups and the exact artifacts we can provide to satisfy your audit:

Summary of ask (from our call):
- Provide audit logs showing who accessed customer data (who/what/when) for the last 45 days
- Export format suitable for ingestion into your SIEM (CSV or NDJSON) + schema
- Include identifiers that map Redwood user/service accounts to your SSO identity (email or external_id)
- Indicate if payload/content was accessed or only metadata (and whether full payload exports are possible)
- Confirm fields included (IP addresses, timestamps in UTC, action types, model and route IDs)
- Retention policy and whether longer retention is possible for Dedicated/Private deployments
- Evidence of export (hash of exported file, who performed export and when)

What we can provide now:
- Time-ordered audit log export (NDJSON or CSV) with the following fields: timestamp_utc, action, resource_type, resource_id, user_email, user_id, ip_address, model_id, route, request_id, payload_present (boolean)
- Sample schema file (attached: audit_log_schema_sample.json)
- One-off export covering any window you request (we typically turn around within 3 business days) as a downloadable CSV/NDJSON. We will supply an SHA256 checksum and an audit entry showing who ran the export.
- Hosted customers: default retention is 90 days for detailed logs; Dedicated/Private customers can request extended retention in contract (we can surface exported logs going back further if you are on a Dedicated plan or require a special export).

Open items for you to confirm:
1) Exact UTC time window you want us to export (please confirm start and end)
2) Whether you require full request/response payloads or metadata-only (metadata excludes user-provided content)
3) Whether IP addresses need to be redacted or pseudonymized in the export

Next steps / timeline:
- If you confirm window + payload preference today, we’ll scope and deliver a sample schema + a one-off export by EOD Thursday (18 Jun).

I’ve cc'd Aditya (security lead on exports) and Ben (your AM) so they can weigh in on the retention/export mechanics.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: audit_log_schema_sample.json (JSON, 4 KB)]

From: Rachel Adams <r.adams@fincobank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fincobank Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs — post-call recap & requested evidence

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the clear list. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Window: initially we'd like 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-06-14T23:59:59Z to cover the ramp period.
2) We prefer NDJSON (one JSON object per line) for ingestion into our SIEM, but can accept CSV if NDJSON isn’t feasible.
3) We do need the IP address and timestamp in logs. For PII concerns, we can accept IP addresses pseudonymized (sha256) if original IPs are not exportable.
4) Full payloads: we’d like metadata-only first. If the metadata shows evidence of content access, we may request a limited payload export for specific request_ids.
5) Export evidence: please include the SHA256 and the user who ran the export. If possible, include a chain-of-custody note (who approved, when).

Also, can you confirm whether the hosted logs include the KMS key id used for encryption or any object id for exported files? Our compliance requires seeing whether exports were encrypted with a customer-managed key.

If you can confirm feasibility and the expected delivery date for the NDJSON sample, we’ll route internally and confirm formally.

Best,
Rachel Adams
Head of InfoSec Programs | Fincobank
r.adams@fincobank.com | +1 (212) 555-6789

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Adams <r.adams@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs — post-call recap & requested evidence

Hi Rachel —

Quick answers to your technical questions:

- Format: We can produce NDJSON (preferred) or CSV. NDJSON will include one JSON object per line with the schema Marissa attached.
- Fields: Export will include timestamp_utc (ISO8601), action (read/write/export), resource_type (e.g., prompt, embedding, model), resource_id, request_id, user_email (if available via SSO), user_id (internal), ip_address (raw) OR ip_address_hash (sha256) depending on your PII preference.
- Payload: We can do metadata-only (no user content) by default. If you need payload for specific request_ids, we can run scoped exports but require approval and an audit entry.
- Retention: Hosted default = 90 days for detailed logs. For Dedicated/Private we support extended retention (per contract, e.g., 12–24 months). If you are on Hosted and need backfill >90 days we can provide a one-off historical export if logs exist in cold storage (we’ll check availability).
- Export evidence: Exports are signed by the operator’s SSO account. We’ll provide SHA256 of the exported file and a system audit entry (who/when) and, if requested, a signed attestation PDF. Exports are encrypted in transit; storage encryption depends on deployment (CMK available for Dedicated/Private).

Action items from our side:
- I’ll generate a small sample NDJSON (covering a 48-hour window) showing schema and fields.
- If you confirm the 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-14 window and metadata-only preference, we’ll schedule the full export. Target turnaround: 3 business days from confirmation.

Questions for you:
- Do you require original IPs, or is sha256(ip) acceptable? If sha256, please confirm salt policy (we can provide salted or unsalted hashes — salted improves privacy but is harder to correlate across vendors).
- Do you need KMS key ids included? If so, we can include the CMK id used to encrypt the exported artifact for Dedicated/Private customers; for Hosted, export archives are encrypted with our platform keys, but we can provide a signed export attestation.

I'll prepare the sample and attach it here.

- Aditya
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
[Attachment: audit_log_sample_ndjson.ndjson (NDJSON, 48 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Adams <r.adams@fincobank.com>, Fincobank Security Team <security@fincobank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs — post-call recap & requested evidence

Thanks Rachel — that window and metadata-only works for us as a starting point. Confirming:
- Window: 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-06-14T23:59:59Z
- Export type: NDJSON (preferred) with ip_address_hash (sha256, unsalted) — please confirm if you later want salted hashes
- Deliverables: sample NDJSON schema + 48-hour sample (today), full one-off export (3 business days after formal confirmation), SHA256 checksum + system audit entry for the export

Please confirm agreement on the above and we’ll kick off the export. If approved, we’ll upload the artifact to a secure share and send the download link and checksum.

Ben — looping you in for billing/contract notes in case extended retention or CMK is requested.

Rachel — if you want the CMK/KMS id in the artifact metadata and you are on a Dedicated plan (or want a contract amendment), we can include that. Otherwise we’ll provide a signed export attestation for Hosted.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
